variable_percentage_formula.formula_nature: Sigmoidal/logistic response curve; NOT a linear formula with a 9.5-ft or 8.5-ft denominator

formula_variables.x: Official Gatun Lake elevation in feet (rounded to one decimal place)
formula_variables.center_parameter: Modified from 82.0 ft down to 79.0 ft under Advisory A-42-2023 (effective 2023-10-01)

variable_percentage_formula.measurement_presumption: Explicitly prescribes the water level of Gatun Lake recorded at 1200 hours on the day prior to transit by the ACP Hydrometeorology Section, applicable to all transits on the following day
variable_percentage_formula.operational_requirement: Evaluating FWS requires runtime dynamic hydrometeorological input (daily 1200 hrs lake elevation). Cannot be evaluated ex-ante in a purely static registry.

dynamic_transit_components.slot_auctions: ACP OP Notice to Shipping N-7-2024. Dynamic market auction clearing prices are non-deterministic ex-ante. Excluded from static deterministic engine.

pc_ums_and_scnt_tonnage_audit.audit_finding: Neither PC/UMS Net Tonnage nor Suez Canal Net Tonnage (SCNT) certificates exist in the Pelagos seed database or public registry sources for any of the 6 seed bulk carriers.

prohibition_of_mathematical_inference.rationale: PC/UMS and SCNT are statutory tonnage measurement systems governed by specific international treaties and canal admeasurement rules. They apply complex geometric deductions for exempted spaces that vary non-linearly with hull geometry, cargo gear, and ballast tank layouts. Mathematical regressions from GT or DWT can deviate by 10% to 25%, producing monetary estimation errors of tens of thousands of dollars per transit.
prohibition_of_mathematical_inference.operational_gate: Operational voyage cost estimation must FAIL CLOSED (CANNOT_ESTIMATE_TARIFF_WITHOUT_CERTIFIED_TONNAGE) when certified PC/UMS or SCNT values are missing.
prohibition_of_mathematical_inference.synthetic_tonnage_prohibition: Synthetic estimation or regression of PC/UMS or SCNT from GT or DWT is strictly prohibited across all operational and research models. Pelagos shall never generate substitute statutory tonnage.
